$comment: A minimal provider of document items (EDP 1.0): social posts from a channel Foresignal has no built-in adapter for. Documentation only.

Target social (prompt 138) turns each social-post document into a 135 social-post record {platform}:{id} under this provider, with collection import: a sample that never feeds velocity baselines unless the stream declares complete: true. Narratives, claims and the social-versus-physical comparison (136, 137) then include them.
properties.platform (or the binding's config.platform) names the network; repostOf/quoteOf/replyTo let reposts inherit the original's originator, so amplification never adds evidence.
An article document (documentType article, with a url) bound with target news joins 133 stories and coverage; no byline is stored.
